name: alert_level
meaning: impact-based alert: 'green', 'yellow', 'orange' or 'red'

name: alert_rank
meaning: alert as a number: 0 green, 1 yellow, 2 orange, 3 red

name: alert_stage
meaning: the AA stage alert_level corresponds to: 'monitoring', 'warning', 'readiness' or 'activation' -- readiness/activation line up with this engine's own plan stages ('readiness', 'activated')

name: alert_hazard
meaning: 'flood / waterlogging' or 'drought / dry spell'

name: p_heavy
meaning: chance of >= 50 mm of rain in week 1 (0-1, ECMWF ensemble)

name: p_dry_spell
meaning: chance of a 7-day dry spell within 15 days (0-1)

name: p_wet_spell
meaning: chance of a 3-day wet spell in week 1 (0-1)

name: week1_rain_mm
meaning: median rain expected in week 1 (mm)

name: week2_rain_mm
meaning: median rain expected in week 2 (mm)

name: soil_z
meaning: root-zone soil moisture z-score (>= 0.75 wet, <= -0.75 dry)

name: soil_deficit_mm
meaning: root-zone soil water below the seasonal median (mm)

name: rain_30d_pct
meaning: last 30 days of rain as % of normal

name: pop_total
meaning: county population (2025 estimate)

name: pop_flood_prone
meaning: people on ground that has flooded before

name: dry_spell_days
meaning: observed days since the last wet county-day (GSMaP)

name: p_soil_recovery
meaning: chance that 2 weeks of rain refill the soil deficit (0-1, ECMWF ensemble)

name: news_flood
meaning: True when news reported flooding or heavy rainfall in the county (last 21 days); supports a red alert but is not required for one

name: news_drought
meaning: True when news reported drought or a dry spell in the county (last 21 days); supports a red alert but is not required for one

name: river_level_m
meaning: latest satellite water level at the county gauge (m)

name: river_age_days
meaning: days since that satellite pass

name: river_rate_m_per_day
meaning: rise (+) or fall (-) at the last pass (m per day)

name: river_rising
meaning: True when the rate is above zero

name: river_pctile
meaning: seasonal percentile of the last pass: how unusual for the time of year (0-100)

name: river_rise_m
meaning: rise since this year's dry-season low (February-May) at the gauge (m)

name: lvl_2yr_m
meaning: 2-year flood level at the gauge (m)

name: lvl_5yr_m
meaning: 5-year flood level (m)

name: lvl_10yr_m
meaning: 10-year flood level (m)

name: readiness_level_m
meaning: readiness water level, when the county rule uses levels (else 2-year level - 0.25 m if the county has no aa_triggers.csv row)

name: activation_level_m
meaning: activation water level, when the county rule uses levels (else the 2-year level)

name: readiness_value
meaning: readiness value of the county's trigger signal (units depend on trigger_family)

name: activation_value
meaning: activation value of the county's trigger signal

name: regional_value
meaning: regional index needed together with the county signal (combined rules)

name: sudd_upstream_pct
meaning: experimental Sudd river trigger: upstream percentile (0-1)

name: sudd_status
meaning: 'normal', 'watch' or 'elevated'

name: flooded_now_km2
meaning: area flooded now (latest Sentinel-1 extent, km2)

name: flooded_now_share
meaning: share of the county flooded now (0-1)

name: month
meaning: month of the run, 1-12
